---
title: Build and Brainstorm
description: Build writes code. Brainstorm asks questions and writes no code.
sidebar:
  order: 3
---

**Run mode** is **Build** or **Brainstorm**.

- **Build** — the AI writes and changes code in the project. Use it when you want a working app.
- **Brainstorm** — the AI asks questions and proposes a plan. It does not write code. Use it when the idea is still open.

**Where to switch**

- On `/projects/new`, a segmented **Run mode** control sits next to the model selector.
- In the editor, open **Run configuration** (top bar) and switch **Run mode** in the dropdown. There is no segmented control in the editor.

You can switch modes between turns. You cannot change the mode while a turn is running.

After Brainstorm produces a plan, confirm with **Start building**. See [Confirm the plan](/agent/approve-plan/).
